objective: Implement app/jobs.py (in-memory JobStore with the exact C2 record shape, including customer_id, and the JobStore API) and app/services/worker.py (a single worker loop that takes next_queued jobs, marks them running, calls the injected renderer with (job.customer_id, job.lang) per C3, and marks done/failed), with unit tests driving both against a stub renderer.

concepts: in-process background thread (daemon) over an in-memory queue
deterministic testing of a worker loop (injectable renderer + explicit step for tests)

inputs: frozen contract C2 (job record + JobStore API, this task owns it)
frozen contract C3 (renderer signature, consumed as a stub)

frozen_contracts.spec: job record shape: {job_id: 'j<n>', report_id: string, customer_id: string, lang: 'en'|'de', status: 'queued'|'running'|'done'|'failed', created_at: int epoch, error: string|null, pdf_ref: string|null}. JobStore API: create(customer_id, report_id, lang) -> job_id; get(job_id) -> record|None; mark_running(job_id); mark_done(job_id, pdf_ref); mark_failed(job_id, error); next_queued() -> job_id|None.

render_report_pdf(customer_id: str, lang: str) -> bytes — renders one PDF page per report of the customer, fetching report data exclusively via app/queries.py, labels from the C4 label tables for the given lang; returns a non-empty byte string starting with b'%PDF'.

non_goals: no disk persistence for jobs (in-memory only, per A-IN-PROCESS)
implementation_constraints: JobStore API must match C2 verbatim: create(customer_id, report_id, lang) -> job_id; get/mark_running/mark_done/mark_failed/next_queued
worker catches ANY exception from the renderer and converts it to mark_failed(str(exc)) — the thread must never die silently
worker must expose a deterministic entry point for tests (e.g. step_once()) so tests never sleep on real threads
job ids follow 'j<n>' with a monotonically increasing counter

acceptance_tests.description: create('c1', 'r1', 'en') returns 'j1'; the job record has customer_id 'c1', status 'queued', lang and created_at set; next_queued returns it; mark_done stores pdf_ref and status 'done'
renderer stub raising RuntimeError('boom') -> the worker marks the job status 'failed' with error 'boom'; the job remains retrievable; the worker survives and processes the next queued job
full step with stub renderer: queued -> running -> done, the stub received (job.customer_id, job.lang) exactly as recorded in the job record, pdf_ref = the stub's returned token
get(unknown) returns None; mark_running on unknown id raises KeyError; next_queued on empty store returns None

failure_cases.expected_behavior: the job record is marked status 'failed' with the exception text; the worker continues with the next job
next_queued returns None; the worker idles (or stops its loop) without error

handoff.notes: step_once() is the test seam; the real thread loop wraps it. T04 codes against the C2 spec only (stub store) — do not import app/jobs.py in T04 tests.
